digest: Two-file, opt-in pi-subagent API recording change affecting the shared backend loader, lifecycle calls, and replay inputs.
changeSummary: Adds an environment-gated recorder around the real @agwab/pi-subagent/api module. Recording writes call outcomes and API-surface metadata; unset or blank configuration preserves the original API object, and injected test APIs bypass recording.

changeInputs.verification: Both post-change files inspected; git history not independently queried.

affectedFiles.responsibility: Environment gating, JSON projection, API wrapping, and synchronous recording-file writes.
Applies maybeRecordSubagentApi to the dynamically imported real API before caching it.

affectedComponents.impact: Recording configuration is evaluated when the cached real API is initialized. Later environment changes do not reconfigure an existing cached API.
Enabled recording covers capability checks, launches, durable-barrier operations, reconciliation, status polling, and interruption through the shared API.
The same loader also records one-shot auto-routing calls and optional parent-child event calls, not only scheduled workflow tasks.
Adds synchronous filesystem work and lossy JSON projection on the API execution path. Recording errors are not isolated from API outcomes.

Existing replay helpers consume calls.jsonl and api-surface.json. The direct recorder test exercises disabled mode, synchronous success, asynchronous success/rejection, and function/AbortSignal projection.

publicSurfaces.name: PI_WORKFLOW_RECORD_DIR
publicSurfaces.behavior: A trimmed nonempty value enables recording to that directory; unset or whitespace-only values disable it.

publicSurfaces.name: calls.jsonl
publicSurfaces.behavior: Appends an entry on synchronous exit or promise settlement. Sequence numbers are local to each wrapper.

publicSurfaces.name: api-surface.json
publicSurfaces.behavior: Overwritten during wrapper creation with sorted enumerable export names, including methods never invoked.

publicSurfaces.name: @agwab/pi-subagent/api
publicSurfaces.behavior: All enumerable function exports except syntactically detected ES classes are wrapped; nonfunction values and detected classes retain their identities.
